correctness.rationale: Normalized Fourier isometry and erased Gram identity give the exact singular-value problem. Explicit 3x3 diagonalization yields the radical formula. Strict Perron matrix comparison for N>=8 and a uniform analytic 2+sqrt bound for N=6,7 rule out all nonconsecutive masks. Vandermonde full rank gives positivity. Unique top eigenline yields all equality signals. The checker independently enumerates all masks N=6..40; finite computations are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Solves a natural complete adversarial three-site erasure problem for a nontrivial cyclic bandlimited Hilbert space. The exact worst-case noise amplification and full equality geometry sharpen fixed-burst prolate eigenvalue computations by comparing every irregular mask; N=6 is a sharp minimal-redundancy boundary. No unsupported generalization to higher bandwidth or more erasures is asserted.
